tools.name: search
tools.description: Search live English-teaching jobs in South Korea on LucyESL by free text. Returns ids, titles and URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one LucyESL job listing by id as a plain-text document with its facts.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Filter the live LucyESL board of English-teaching jobs in South Korea: region, student age, housing, visa, schedule, contract, setting, direct hire, minimum salary, free text. Returns structured records; pay in KRW per month unless stated otherwise; null means the advert did not say.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One live listing as a structured record.

tools.name: salary_stats
tools.description: English-teacher salary statistics for South Korea computed from the live listings: median, quartiles, by region, by employer type, effective pay per teaching hour, disclosure rates, housing. CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: disclosure_stats
tools.description: How many live Korean ESL job adverts state the salary, hours, severance, pension, insurance, airfare, vacation and split shifts. CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Live English-teaching job adverts in South Korea counted by region: how many in each, direct hire against recruiters, how many state total on-site hours, and the median advertised salary where the sample allows. Counts of adverts, not of employers. CC BY 4.0.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search live English-teaching jobs in South Korea on LucyESL by free text. Returns ids, titles and URLs; use fetch for a listing's details." → after: "Search live English-teaching jobs in South Korea on LucyESL by free text. Returns ids, titles and URLs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
